products.name: QuoteSweep: Margin-Safe Cleaning Quote Calculator
products.unique_concept: Quote calculator that works BACKWARDS from the owner's real labor+overhead cost and target margin, then shows the per-room price and a shareable client-facing estimate page; competitors only add up line items.
products.pain_points: Underquoting; phone quotes by gut; per-seat software fees
products.pitch_points: Never lose money on a job; quote in 60 seconds; no monthly fee; client gets a clean estimate link/printable
features: Cost settings (labor $/hr, overhead $/hr, target margin %, tax %)
Room-by-room task minutes table (editable)
Condition multiplier (light/normal/heavy), pets, add-ons (oven, fridge, windows, inside cabinets)
Margin check with red/green warning
Recurring discount (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly) with margin impact
Printable/PDF-able client estimate (browser print), saved quotes in localStorage, JSON export
products.build_spec: Single-file index.html (use tools/builders core). Fields: bedrooms, bathrooms, sqft, kitchens, condition, pets(bool), add-ons[]. Formulas: minutes = sum(room_minutes x condition_mult); cost = hours x (labor + overhead) x crew_size; price = cost / (1 - target_margin) (ZenMaid-style divide-by-(1-margin); label clearly, NOT markup) ; recurring price = price x (1 - discount); margin_after_discount = (price_after - cost)/price_after. Sample data: labor $18, overhead $20, 25% -> $50.67/hr (matches C10 example). Tests: node test of formula functions + phone-width browser check.

products.build_spec: Single-file HTML app. Data model client{id,name,start,freq,price,cleaner,events[]}. Event types: complaint, reschedule, cleaner_change, no_reply, praise, price_increase. Score = 10 x complaint + 5 x reschedule(last 30d) + 8 x cleaner_change + 6 x no_reply - 5 x praise, capped 0-100; bands <30 green, 30-60 amber, >60 red (rule is OUR heuristic; state this in README, no claim of statistical validity). Retention % = active at 90d / started in cohort. Sample data labelled as sample. Test: scoring unit tests + phone-width check.
